msm

Class MsmX

  • java.lang.Object
    • meico.xml.XmlBase
      • meico.msm.AbstractMsm
        • meico.msm.Msm
          • msm.MsmX
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable

    public class MsmX
extends meico.msm.Msm
    This is an extension of meico's MSM class. The MsmElement object is an object that builds upon functionality of the meico's MPM. However, this is not at a state where it can become part of meico!
